About Solum Health

Solum automates the insurance work behind outpatient care: verifying benefits, getting prior authorizations approved, and finding coverage patients didn't know they had.

For an outpatient provider group, every new patient sets off the same chain of admin work. Someone checks the patient's coverage on an insurer's website, works out what's actually covered, calls the insurer when the website doesn't answer the question, pulls clinical documents together for an authorization, faxes it, and follows up for days. When any step is late or wrong, the patient's start date slips or the claim gets denied.
